faqs.question: What products are available in the supermarket?
faqs.answer: We provide groceries, vegetables, fruits, dairy products, beverages, snacks, household items, personal care products, and more.

faqs.question: What are the supermarket opening hours?
faqs.answer: Store timings vary depending on location and business hours.

faqs.question: Is the supermarket open on holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes, the supermarket may remain open on holidays depending on the store schedule.

faqs.question: Do you provide home delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, home delivery services are available for selected locations.

faqs.question: Is delivery available in my area?
faqs.answer: Delivery availability depends on your location and service coverage area.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Delivery time depends on order size, traffic, and location.

faqs.question: Can I place orders online?
faqs.answer: Yes, orders can be placed through our website, app, WhatsApp, or phone.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum order amount for delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, minimum order requirements may apply for delivery services.

faqs.question: Are there delivery charges?
faqs.answer: Delivery charges may apply depending on order amount and distance.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: We accept cash, debit cards, credit cards, UPI, wallets, and online payments.

faqs.question: Do you accept UPI payments?
faqs.answer: Yes, all major UPI payment methods are accepted.

faqs.question: Can I pay using debit or credit cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, debit and credit cards are accepted.

faqs.question: Is cash payment accepted?
faqs.answer: Yes, cash payments are accepted at the store.

faqs.question: Do you have offers or discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes, we regularly provide discounts, combo offers, and seasonal promotions.

faqs.question: Do you have a loyalty or rewards program?
faqs.answer: Yes, customers may earn reward points or discounts through loyalty programs.

faqs.question: Do you provide membership cards?
faqs.answer: Yes, membership programs may be available with special benefits.

faqs.question: Do you sell fresh vegetables and fruits?
faqs.answer: Yes, fresh fruits and vegetables are available daily.

faqs.question: Do you sell dairy products?
faqs.answer: Yes, milk, curd, butter, cheese, and other dairy products are available.

faqs.question: Do you have bakery products?
faqs.answer: Yes, bread, cakes, biscuits, and bakery items are available.

faqs.question: Do you sell frozen food items?
faqs.answer: Yes, frozen food products are available in selected categories.

faqs.question: Do you sell organic products?
faqs.answer: Yes, selected organic and healthy food products are available.

faqs.question: Do you sell household products?
faqs.answer: Yes, cleaning supplies, kitchen items, and household essentials are available.

faqs.question: Do you sell personal care products?
faqs.answer: Yes, soaps, shampoos, skincare, and personal care items are available.

faqs.question: Do you accept bulk orders?
faqs.answer: Yes, bulk and wholesale orders may be accepted depending on stock availability.

faqs.question: How can I check product availability?
faqs.answer: You can contact the store or check through our online platforms.

faqs.question: Do you sell branded products?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide products from multiple trusted brands.

faqs.question: Can I return or exchange products?
faqs.answer: Yes, returns or exchanges are accepted according to store policy.

faqs.question: What if I receive damaged products?
faqs.answer: Damaged products can be reported for replacement or refund according to policy.

faqs.question: Will I get a bill or receipt?
faqs.answer: Yes, printed or digital bills are provided after purchase.

faqs.question: Is parking available at the supermarket?
faqs.answer: Parking facilities may be available depending on store location.

faqs.question: How can I contact the supermarket?
faqs.answer: You can contact us through phone, WhatsApp, email, or direct visit.

faqs.question: Do you provide WiFi for customers?
faqs.answer: WiFi availability depends on store facilities.

faqs.question: Do you provide carry bags?
faqs.answer: Yes, carry bags may be available depending on store policy.

faqs.question: Do you have self-checkout counters?
faqs.answer: Self-checkout facilities may be available at selected locations.

faqs.question: Do you provide gift cards or vouchers?
faqs.answer: Yes, gift cards or shopping vouchers may be available.

faqs.question: Do you sell pet food and pet care products?
faqs.answer: Yes, selected pet food and pet care items are available.

faqs.question: Do you sell baby care products?
faqs.answer: Yes, diapers, baby food, and baby care items are available.

faqs.question: What if billing counters are crowded?
faqs.answer: Additional counters may be opened during peak hours to reduce waiting time.

faqs.question: Do you provide festival offers?
faqs.answer: Yes, special festival discounts and promotions are available during selected seasons.
